summary: Alpha Compute Corp, a BVI-domiciled Nasdaq-listed AI compute infrastructure issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 25, 2026 announcing it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. Nasdaq had notified the company on March 2, 2026 of a 30-business-day deficiency; the Staff determined the closing bid held at or above $1.00 for 11 consecutive business days from September 9 through September 23, 2026, closing the matter. No advisor, fee, or pricing terms were disclosed; the notice is informational. Watch for renewed sub-$1 pressure or reverse-split risk.
